selection_policy.required: Cases exercising an included predicate/expression or accepted source/wire syntax, under applicable corrected semantics. A failing included case stays a failure.
selection_policy.adapt: read/write harness operations are replaced by node goal/source/answer round trips when that preserves the tested property; otherwise test the internal reader separately.
selection_policy.outside_profile: Unrestricted stream/file I/O, database mutation, arbitrary directives, user flag/operator mutation, actors and nonselected library extensions. Test denial separately; never use sandbox denial as an ISO semantic pass.
selection_policy.conditional: Declared integer/character limits, locale/float assumptions, implementation-defined choices and multiple allowed outcomes require explicit preconditions or allowed-outcome sets.
selection_policy.pending: All unselected rows are unreviewed, not automatically excluded or passed. No claim of complete upstream-suite adoption.
selection_policy.safety: Do not download-and-execute a whole suite or enable forbidden predicates to run it.
